The witness report does not mention any game discs or digital library screenshots.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'Manage storage devices' screen in settings.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.

risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may have overheating issues or a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console running a game for several minutes.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used with a controller tester app.

risks.risk: The mentioned games may be digital licenses tied to the seller's account, not transferable.

Photos of the 6 game discs mentioned.
Screenshot of the system storage settings.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the item is an Xbox One console with a controller, allowing for a worst-case valuation despite missing functional proof.
